remarks: Utilities included! This 2 bed one bath unit in an adult community has been completely remodeled. Enjoy brand-new laminate flooring, gleaming appliances and cabinets, and freshly painted interiors, totally move-in ready so you can settle in with ease. There are ample closets, including two oversized hall closets! Plus, you'll love the convenience of an assigned parking space just steps away and your own private storage unit in the lower level. Rent includes heat, AC, water, and electricity, making this a terrific value. The Kingswood offers fantastic amenities like a fully equipped fitness center, cozy great room with a fireplace and pool table, a movie theater/business center, with wifi, and a sunny courtyard patio, with a grilling area, ideal for relaxing or entertaining. There are fun monthly events, should you choose to participate. Located close to I-95, public transportation, downtown Stamford, shops, and dining. This rare findis the lifestyle you've waited for! Unpack, unwind, and start enjoying your new home. Welcome to The Kingswood-where comfort meets community! Good credit and references are a must. This incredible value in a wonderful location won't last!
